title: Traffic Orchestration Studio: visual policy editor, validation rules, and live preview for region/tier/fallback routing
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description:
Goal: Ship a customer-facing Policy Editor inside the Redwood Console that lets product teams declare routing policies across region, capacity tier, and model fallback variants. The editor should be visual (drag/compose rules), provide deterministic validation with human-readable errors, and a live preview that simulates a request stream across regions and tiers so customers can understand routing behavior before saving.

Scope: - Visual rule canvas with blocks for selectors (region, tier, model tag, customer label) and actions (route to model variant, split-traffic, fallback order). - Validation engine that checks for unreachable paths, circular fallbacks, unsupported region-model pairings, and quota/permission violations. - Live preview simulator that accepts sample requests or a small request trace and shows step-by-step routing decisions and probability/latency/cost estimates. - Integrations: tie into routing catalog (model variants metadata), region capacity catalog, and RBAC/teams for enforceable constraints. - UX: inline suggestions for auto-fixes and a compact declarative JSON view for copy/paste into infra-as-code.

Out of scope for this ticket: autoscaling policy editor, billing estimator beyond simple per-token cost delta, and backend enforcement telemetry ingestion (separately tracked).
acceptance_criteria: Customers can create a new routing policy using the visual canvas and persist it to a named policy in the Console.
Validation rules run on save and surface clear, actionable errors and warnings (e.g., 'Region eu-west-1 has no compatible model variant for model-x').
Live preview accepts a sample request or uploaded CSV of up to 100 requests and shows the resolved route, selected model variant, and estimated token-latency/cost for each request row.
Saved policy is represented as a compact JSON that can be exported/imported and matches the runtime schema used by the routing service.
Frontend includes unit and e2e tests for the editor interactions and validation journeys; engineering adds basic integration tests with mock model/region catalog endpoints.

risk_and_mitigation: Risk: Misconfigured fallbacks may leak customer data across regions. Mitigation: block policies that route requests to a region not approved by the organization-level allowed_regions list; surface warnings in the editor.
Risk: Large previews cause runtime cost. Mitigation: limit preview trace to 100 rows and run simulator on a low-cost mock path; show estimated cost before running.
Risk: Complex rule graphs can be hard to reason about. Mitigation: provide an auto-simplify suggestion and a textual summary of the effective routing decision for top N traffic paths.
notes: Follow-up tickets will be created for: - integration with Dedicated capacity autoscaling hooks - audit logging for policy changes - rollout gating (canary + A/B) UI
Design asked for two accessibility reviews: color contrast on the visualization canvas, and screen-reader-friendly compact JSON view.
QA will run a small red-team exercise to validate that policy validation prevents illegitimate cross-region routing.
